dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: My research into these nets is still ongoing, but I've got to say that I'm not making any progress at all.

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: I've not been able to achieve the levels of sturdiness, utility, or any other parameter for that matter, that Sango told me were possible...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: Where did we go wrong, I wonder...

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: I—I mean, Sango couldn't have remembered that onmyoudou technique wrongly... Right?

dialogues.speaker: Wakamurasaki
dialogues.text: I'll go ask her when the opportunity arises, just to be sure...
